full.description: This is a dental or facial X-ray showing the jawbone area. A large, well-defined radiolucent lesion is visible within the mandible. The surrounding bone architecture is altered by the expansile lesion. The most likely diagnosis for this large radiolucency in the jaw is an ameloblastoma or another odontogenic cyst/tumor.
